sourceTitle: Highland Council Fostering & Adoption Allowances 2026/2027 (The Highland Council)

allowances.label: 16 to 18
allowances.note: The allowance stops on the young person's 18th birthday unless the carer is told otherwise

fees.label: Specialist carers
fees.note: Paid for the eldest child in placement

feesNote: The council's schedule shows weekly fees for specialist and intensive carers, plus lower half-week fees for stays of three nights or less; it does not show a full-week fee for mainstream carers, so ask the fostering team which fee would apply to you.
extras: A birthday payment of one week's allowance for each child
A summer payment of £215 for each child
A Christmas payment of £107 for each child
summary: The Highland Council pays a weekly allowance for each child by age, and its 2026-27 rates match the Scottish Government's recommended allowance for this year. Specialist and intensive carers receive a weekly fee on top, and every child in placement attracts birthday, summer and Christmas payments.
